ideas.title: LiveOps incident filer
ideas.one_liner: Watches live game telemetry and files structured LiveOps tickets with the event and segment attached.
ideas.smallest_version: A script that reads a CSV of event KPIs and writes tickets for anomalies.
ideas.demo: A KPI spike appears and a ticket with the event name and segment pops up.
ideas.verifiable_by: A golden set of 30 KPI files with known anomalies, checked by a script.
ideas.rahul_edge: Knows which KPI drops matter during an event and which are noise.

ideas.title: Experiment ticket planner
ideas.one_liner: Turns an AI PM's experiment backlog into tickets packed into the next sprint by size.
ideas.smallest_version: A CLI that reads a YAML backlog and prints a sprint plan.
ideas.demo: A messy backlog becomes a two-week plan in one command.
ideas.verifiable_by: Packing maths checked against 5 worked examples.

originality.differentiator: Existing planners order experiments by impact only; this packs them by size into a sprint.

ideas.title: Anti-planner
ideas.one_liner: Removes tasks from your week until it fits instead of scheduling them.
ideas.smallest_version: A web page that takes a list and crosses items out.
ideas.demo: A list of 20 tasks shrinks to 6.
ideas.verifiable_by: Unit tests on the pruning rule.

web: app that removes tasks from your week

originality.kill_reason: example/anti-todo (2,000 stars, pushed last month) does exactly this.

ideas.title: Event map blockout
ideas.one_liner: Turns a LiveOps event brief into a blockout map for the event's arena.
ideas.smallest_version: A prompt and a renderer for a 16 by 16 grid.
ideas.demo: A one-line event brief becomes a playable grid.
ideas.verifiable_by: Grid validity checks in a script.

ideas.title: Weekly plan for anyone
ideas.one_liner: A general weekly planner with no gaming or AI product angle.
